info.title: SmartCart AI Backend API
info.description: REST API for SmartCart AI: auth, OAuth2.0, products, AI semantic search, personalized recommendations, cart, orders, payments (Stripe + COD), reviews, notifications, wishlist, support tickets (Socket.IO), admin dashboard, and Pinecone vector sync

password.description: Must contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one special character

ProfileUpdate.description: At least one field must be provided

password.description: Must contain uppercase, lowercase, number and special character

paymentMethod.description: stripe = online card payment via Stripe; cod = cash on delivery

body.example: Ali, only 2 items left — complete your order 🔥

refId.description: ObjectId of the triggering resource (Order, Ticket, Cart, or Payment)

post.summary: Register new user
Login with email and password
Upload user avatar
post.description: Accepts multipart/form-data with field name `avatar` (single image, max 2 MB). Uploads to Cloudinary and updates the user's profile picture. Returns the new Cloudinary URL.

avatar.description: Image file (jpg, jpeg, png, webp — max 2 MB)

400.description: No file provided or invalid file type

post.summary: Request a password reset email
post.description: Always returns 200 regardless of whether the email exists — prevents user enumeration. Check the inbox for a reset link (valid 10 min).

200.description: Reset link sent (or silently ignored if email not found)

post.summary: Set a new password using the emailed token
post.description: Token is the raw value from the reset link query string (?token=...). Valid for 10 minutes. Invalidates all existing sessions on success.

post.summary: Register or clear a Firebase Cloud Messaging device token
post.description: Call after login (or when the FCM token refreshes) to enable push notifications. Pass `fcmToken: null` to deregister (e.g. on logout or when user opts out).

post.summary: Log a user action (view, wishlist, search, review)
post.description:
Call from the frontend when the user performs an action that cannot be inferred server-side (e.g. viewing a product page, adding to wishlist, submitting a search query).
`purchase` and `add_to_cart` are auto-logged server-side — do NOT duplicate them here.
Extra context fields: - `durationSeconds` — how long the product page was open (action: view) - `query` — the search string (action: search) - `rating` — star rating 1–5 (action: review)

productId.description: MongoDB ObjectId — omit for search logs

200.description: Cart object with items and total

post.summary: Add item to cart

400.description: Product not found or validation error

put.summary: Update item quantity (set to 0 to remove)

delete.summary: Remove a specific item from cart

post.summary: Create a category (Admin)

get.summary: Get a single category by slug
Get all subcategories of a category

post.summary: Add a subcategory to a category (Admin)

get.description:
Redirects the browser to Google's consent screen.
After the user grants permission Google redirects back to
`/api/oauth/google/callback` where a JWT is issued and the
browser is forwarded to the frontend with the token in the
query string: `{CLIENT_URL}/oauth/callback?token=<jwt>`

Google redirects here after the user approves/denies access.
On success the browser is redirected to:
`{CLIENT_URL}/oauth/callback?token=<jwt>`
On failure it redirects to:
`{CLIENT_URL}/login?error=oauth_failed`

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Authorization code provided by Google (handled automatically)

302.description: Redirect to frontend with JWT token

get.summary: Get current OAuth / JWT authenticated user
get.description: Works for both local JWT and OAuth JWT tokens.

post.summary: Logout — client-side token discard instruction
post.description:
JWT is stateless — this endpoint simply returns a success response
as a hint for the frontend to delete its stored token.
For session-based OAuth flows the session is also destroyed.

get.description:
Redirects the browser to Facebook's login / consent dialog.
After approval Facebook redirects back to `/api/oauth/facebook/callback`
where a JWT is issued and the browser is forwarded to:
`{CLIENT_URL}/oauth/callback?token=<jwt>`

Facebook redirects here after the user approves/denies access.
On success the browser is redirected to:
`{CLIENT_URL}/oauth/callback?token=<jwt>`
On failure it redirects to:
`{CLIENT_URL}/login?error=oauth_failed`

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Authorization code provided by Facebook (handled automatically)

302.description: Redirect to frontend with JWT token

post.summary: Place new order and create Stripe PaymentIntent
post.description: Idempotent — send an `Idempotency-Key` header (UUID) to prevent duplicate orders on network retries or double-clicks. Same key returns the cached response.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional unique key (UUID). Repeated requests with the same key return the original response.

422.description: Validation error (missing items, missing shippingAddress.city, etc.)

201.description: Order created — returns orderId + clientSecret (Stripe) or orderId only (COD)

clientSecret.description: Stripe PaymentIntent client secret (absent for COD)

amount.description: Order total in smallest currency unit

get.summary: Admin — list COD orders pending collection
get.description: Returns all orders with `paymentMethod: cod` and `paymentStatus: cod_pending` (delivered but cash not yet collected). Accessible by admin and subadmin.

200.description: Array of COD orders awaiting collection

post.summary: Create a Stripe PaymentIntent for an existing order

400.description: Order not found or already paid

post.summary: Stripe webhook — receives raw body, verifies signature
post.description: Do NOT send JSON — Stripe posts raw bytes. Signature verified via STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

get.summary: Get payment record for an order

parameters.name: subcategory
parameters.description: Filter by subcategory slug — use together with category

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Filter by brand name (case-insensitive regex match)

parameters.name: inStock
parameters.description: If true, only return products with stock > 0

post.summary: Create product (Admin)
Upload product images (Admin)
post.description: Accepts up to 6 image files via multipart/form-data (field name: `images`). Each file max 5 MB. Uploads to Cloudinary and appends URLs to the product's images array.

images.description: Image files (jpg, jpeg, png, webp — max 5 MB each)

200.description: Updated product with new image URLs

400.description: Invalid file type or too many files

delete.description: Removes a specific image URL from the product's images array and deletes the asset from Cloudinary.

imageUrl.description: The Cloudinary URL of the image to delete

get.description: Embeds the natural-language query via Gemini text-embedding-004, finds the most semantically similar products in Pinecone, then fetches full product documents from MongoDB. Falls back to MongoDB regex search if Pinecone is not configured.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Natural language search query (e.g. "waterproof running shoes for summer")

200.description: Array of matching products ranked by semantic relevance

get.summary: Search products by name or description
Filter products by category (optionally also subcategory)

parameters.name: subcategory
parameters.description: Optional subcategory slug to narrow results

get.description: Uses the authenticated user's behavior history (views, purchases, cart actions) to build a taste profile, embed it via Gemini, and find the most semantically similar products in Pinecone. Cold start (< 5 actions): returns top-rated products.

200.description: Array of recommended products (personalized or top-rated)

post.summary: Add a review for a product

409.description: User has already reviewed this product

422.description: Validation error (rating required, comment min 3 chars)

get.summary: Get all reviews for a product

200.description: Array of sub-admin users with their assigned cities

post.summary: Promote a user to sub-admin (Admin only)

409.description: Already a sub-admin or is a main admin

delete.summary: Demote a sub-admin back to user (Admin only)

409.description: Not a sub-admin or is a main admin

post.summary: Create a support ticket
post.description: City is auto-detected from the linked order's shippingAddress.city, or from the user's profile address. A subadmin for that city is auto-assigned. If none exists, assignedTo is null (main admin handles it).

orderId.description: Optional — links ticket to an order

get.summary: Get a single ticket with full message history

post.summary: Send a message in a ticket
post.description: Message is persisted in MongoDB AND emitted via Socket.io to all clients in room `ticket_{id}`. Transitions ticket from open → in_progress on first staff reply.

patch.summary: Close a ticket (subadmin for their city, or admin)

post.summary: Manually trigger abandoned cart cron job (Admin only)
post.description: Triggers the same abandoned cart detection job that runs automatically every hour. Finds all carts idle for 1+ hour with reminderSent=false, generates LLM-personalized FCM notifications based on real stock levels (CRITICAL/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH), sends via Firebase, saves notification records to MongoDB, and marks reminderSent=true. Use this endpoint for testing without waiting 1 hour.

get.summary: Get all notifications for the logged-in user (paginated)
get.description: Returns notifications sorted by createdAt descending (newest first). Supports optional isRead filter and pagination. Also returns the total unreadCount for the user as a separate field.

parameters.name: isRead
parameters.description: Filter by read state — omit to return all notifications

200.description: Paginated list of notifications plus unread count

patch.description: Sets isRead=true and readAt=now on every unread notification for the logged-in user. NOTE: This path is registered BEFORE /notifications/{id} in Express to prevent the string 'read-all' being matched as a MongoDB ObjectId parameter.

200.description: All unread notifications marked as read

patch.summary: Mark a single notification as read
patch.description: Sets isRead=true and readAt=now. Only the notification owner can mark it read — 404 is returned if the notification belongs to a different user.

404.description: Notification not found or does not belong to this user

delete.description: Hard-deletes the notification. Only the notification owner can delete it — 404 is returned if the notification belongs to a different user.

404.description: Notification not found or does not belong to this user

get.summary: Get the logged-in user's wishlist with full product details
get.description: Returns the wishlist document with products array fully populated from the products collection. If no wishlist exists yet for the user, returns an empty wishlist shape { userId, products: [] } without creating a document.

post.summary: Add a product to wishlist
post.description: Validates that productId is a valid MongoDB ObjectId and that the product exists. Creates the wishlist document if this is the user's first save (upsert). Returns 409 if the product is already in the wishlist.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the product to add

delete.description: Removes the productId from the wishlist's products array using $pull. Silently succeeds even if the product was not in the wishlist. Returns the updated wishlist with products fully populated.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the product to remove

post.summary: Logout — clears FCM token and deregisters device
post.description: Clears the user's fcmToken field in MongoDB so no further push notifications are sent to this device after logout. JWT is stateless — the client must also delete the token from localStorage or cookies. This endpoint handles local JWT auth logout only. For OAuth session logout use POST /api/oauth/logout.

get.description: Returns paginated users where role='user'. Subadmins and admins are excluded. Supports search by name or email (case-insensitive regex). Never returns passwordHash.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by name or email — case-insensitive partial match

post.summary: Create a new user, sub-admin, or admin account (Admin only)
post.description: Directly creates a new user account with specified details and role (user, subadmin, admin). Subadmins require a city parameter. Created users are marked isVerified=true by default.

city.description: Required only if role is subadmin

get.summary: Get a single user with activity stats (Admin only)
get.description: Returns the full user document (excluding passwordHash) plus computed stats: orderCount, behaviorCount, and totalSpent. Stats are fetched in parallel via Promise.all.

delete.summary: Permanently delete a user and all their data (Admin only)
delete.description: Hard-deletes the user document and cascades to all related collections: orders, behaviors, cart, wishlist, reviews, notifications, tickets. Cannot delete another admin account (returns 403). This action is irreversible.

200.description: User and all related data deleted

message.example: User and all related data deleted

403.description: Admin only — cannot delete another admin account

patch.description: Toggles the isBlocked flag. If currently blocked → unblocks; if unblocked → blocks. Cannot block another admin account (returns 403). Blocked users receive 403 on login attempts.

403.description: Admin only — cannot block another admin account

get.summary: Get overall platform dashboard statistics (Admin only)
get.description: Returns six key platform metrics in a single request. All six MongoDB queries run in parallel via Promise.all for performance. totalRevenue counts only orders where paymentStatus is 'paid' or 'cod_collected'.

get.summary: Order counts by status and by day (Admin + Subadmin)
get.description: Admin sees all orders. Subadmin automatically scoped to orders where shippingAddress.city matches their assigned city — no extra parameter needed. byDay array is sorted ascending by date.

200.description: Order stats by status and by day

byStatus.description: Count of orders per status within the period

byDay.description: Order count per calendar day, sorted ascending

get.description: Only counts orders where paymentStatus is 'paid' or 'cod_collected'. byCategory uses a MongoDB $lookup aggregation to join with the products collection, unwinds order items, and groups by product.category. byDay is sorted ascending. byCategory is sorted by revenue descending.

byDay.description: Revenue summed per calendar day, sorted ascending

byCategory.description: Revenue per product category, sorted descending

post.summary: Re-embed a single product into Pinecone (Admin only)
post.description: Builds an embedding text from product name + description + category + subcategory + tags, sends it to the Gemini embedding API (gemini-embedding-001), and upserts the resulting 1536-dimension vector into Pinecone with metadata (name, category, price, isActive). Sets products.vectorSynced=true in MongoDB on success. Use after editing a product's name or description to keep search results accurate. IMPORTANT: This route is registered BEFORE GET/PUT/DELETE /:id in Express.

503.description: Gemini or Pinecone is not configured

post.summary: Re-embed all unsynced products in background (Admin only)
post.description: Finds all products where vectorSynced=false and starts a non-blocking background job using setImmediate. Returns immediately with a jobId and totalQueued count. Processing includes a 200ms delay between products to avoid Gemini rate limits. Progress is logged to the server console every 10 products. IMPORTANT: This route is registered BEFORE /:id routes in Express to avoid the string 'sync-all-vectors' being matched as a MongoDB ObjectId.

patch.summary: Mark COD order cash as collected (Subadmin city-scoped or Admin)
patch.description: Only valid when order.paymentMethod='cod' AND order.status='delivered'. Atomically updates both order.status and order.paymentStatus to 'cod_collected'. Subadmin can only collect for orders where shippingAddress.city matches their assigned city. Sends a Firebase push notification to the customer on success. Uses a TOCTOU-safe findOneAndUpdate to prevent race conditions.

400.description: Order is not a COD order, or status is not 'delivered' yet

403.description: Subadmin city does not match order's shipping city

409.description: Cash payment already collected for this order

patch.summary: Reassign a ticket to a different subadmin (Admin only)
patch.description: Reassigns an open or in_progress ticket to a different subadmin. Validates that the target subadmin's city matches the ticket's city. Cannot reassign a closed ticket. Sends a Firebase push notification to the newly assigned subadmin if they have an FCM token.

subadminId.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the subadmin to assign

400.description: Ticket is closed and cannot be reassigned, or subadmin city does not match ticket city

404.description: Ticket not found, or target subadmin not found / not a subadmin
